wallpapers.caption: Face Canyon, Lake Powell, Utah
wallpapers.desc: Hidden within an ancient sandstone landscape, Face Canyon is one of 96 canyons stretching out from Lake Powell in southern Utah. Many are far from roads and would be hard to reach if they hadn't been flooded by the lake, created in 1963 during the construction of the Glen Canyon Dam. The lake's waters back up about 186 miles, along creeks and canyons which you can explore by boat, kayak, or personal watercraft.
